mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / parses namespaces, mixed content and UTF-16 offsets
mappings.title: parses namespaces, mixed content and UTF-16 offsets
given: The source XML starts with an XML declaration, a leading comment, and a processing instruction, then a namespaced root ns:root with default, ns, and x namespace declarations and an attribute a="1 & 2".
Inside that root, literal text pre and mid surrounds a self-closing x:child element with x:b="v", followed by a CDATA section whose payload is <tail>, and the document ends with a trailing comment.
when: parseXml reads the document, the root and first child elements are inspected, and elements(...) is queried for the expanded names child/urn:x and root/urn:ns.
then: The parsed document exposes exactly two elements: the ns:root element and the nested x:child element.
The root reports name ns:root, localName root, namespaceURI urn:ns, attributes xmlns, xmlns:ns, xmlns:x, and a decoded to 1 & 2, with aggregate text premid<tail>.
The root keeps exact source offsets for its start tag, open-end, close-start, and end, is not self-closing, has no parent, and points its root reference back to itself.

The child reports name x:child, localName child, namespaceURI urn:x, attributes {"x:b":"v"}, empty text, parent/root references back to the root, selfClosing true, and open/close offsets that collapse onto the same self-closing token.
elements(...) returns the exact child element for child/urn:x and the exact root element for root/urn:ns.
examples: Offset custody: root.start and child.start are compared against the original string indices rather than reconstructed positions.
Namespace expansion: the default namespace applies to unprefixed element names, while x:child resolves specifically to urn:x.

examples: Numeric entity variants reviewed: A and A both become A.
Predefined entity variants reviewed: &, <, >, ", and '.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / expanded attribute lookup honours aliases, local rebinding and unqualified attributes
mappings.title: expanded attribute lookup honours aliases, local rebinding and unqualified attributes
given: The root element binds the default namespace to urn:default, binds both a and r to urn:a, carries an unqualified id="plain", and carries a:id="outer".
Its first child locally rebinds r to urn:b and carries r:id="inner" plus xml:lang="en".
Its second child inherits the outer r binding and carries r:id="sibling".
when: parseXml parses the tree and attribute(...) lookups are performed with and without explicit namespace URIs; the attributeNamespaces map is also inspected directly.
then: attribute(root,"id") returns plain, while attribute(root,"id","urn:default") is undefined because unqualified attributes are not default-namespaced.
attribute(root,"id","urn:a") returns outer from the aliased a:id attribute.
On the locally rebound child, attribute(child,"id","urn:b") returns inner and attribute(child,"id","urn:a") is undefined, proving the local r binding wins over the parent one.
On the sibling child, attribute(other,"id","urn:a") returns sibling through the inherited outer r binding.
attribute(child,"lang",XML_NS) returns en, attributeNamespaces["a:id"] is urn:a, and the attributeNamespaces map is both frozen and null-prototype.
examples: Alias variant reviewed: both a:id and r:id on the root denote the same expanded namespace URI urn:a.
Local rebinding variant reviewed: child-level xmlns:r="urn:b" overrides the parent mapping only within that child.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / rejects malformed or unsafe XML
mappings.title: rejects malformed or unsafe XML
given: A refusal loop exercises malformed XML declaration variants, malformed processing instructions and comments, forbidden DTDs and custom entities, duplicate attributes by spelling and by expanded name, reserved-name misuse, an unbound prefix, mismatched tags, and an illegal control character.
when: Each source string is passed to parseXml inside an exception assertion that also checks the reported error code.
then: Malformed declaration or syntax cases throw XML_MALFORMED.
A DOCTYPE declaration throws XML_DTD_FORBIDDEN, and a custom entity reference throws XML_ENTITY_FORBIDDEN.
Duplicate attributes by raw name or expanded name throw XML_DUPLICATE_ATTRIBUTE.
An unbound prefix throws XML_UNBOUND_PREFIX, mismatched closing tags throw XML_MISMATCHED_TAG, and U+0001 inside text throws XML_INVALID_CHAR.
examples: Malformed declaration cases: <?xml version="1.0" extra="x"?><r/>, <?xml version="1.0" standalone="maybe"?><r/>, and <r a="1"b="2"/>.
Malformed markup cases: <?pi/?>, <xmlns:r/>, <r><!-- bad -- --></r>, and <r><!--bad---></r>.
Security or namespace cases: <!DOCTYPE r><r/>, <r>&custom;</r>, <x:r/>, and <r xmlns="http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace"/>.
Duplicate-name cases: <r a="1" a="2"/> and <r xmlns:x="u" xmlns:y="u" x:a="1" y:a="2"/>.
Tree and character integrity cases: and .
limitations: Fifteen refusal inputs are aggregated under one declaration; this mapping records the reviewed variants but does not split them into separate artifacts.
